purpose: Matched five-way Kestrel v36 change-effect screen against the prior v35 screen: a 250-mineral Probe-production reserve from first Pylon acceptance until second Gateway current, preserving v35 mechanisms
hypothesis: Holding 250 minerals for the second Gateway from first-Pylon acceptance through second-Gateway current suppresses the v35-motivated early Probe opportunity and improves the chance of two completed combat units before the first qualifying ZZZK threat, without regressing v35 construction bookkeeping, emergency episode cap, reserve, staged offense, commandability, provenance, or non-Zerg inactivity gates.
stop_condition: Run exactly five candidate attempts concurrently in the matched prior-v35 scenarios; retain every result and stop after two consecutive infrastructure-invalid attempts, a 900-second cohort cap, or completion. Do not retry, reseed, replace or rerun attempts. Any timeout or missing terminal result is INCONCLUSIVE.

base_candidate.name: Kestrel-v35-construction-bookkeeping-and-emergency-episode-cap
base_candidate.policy: Exact v35 base; add only the registered 250-mineral Probe-production reserve from first-Pylon acceptance until second-Gateway current.

mechanism_reference.construction_fix: capture pendingBuildBaseline=count(type) before issue(), store the pre-command count on accepted builds in build() and buildAssimilator(), release pending only when count(type)>baseline, and reject overlapping construction
mechanism_reference.target: matched ZZZK second Gateway current before first qualifying home threat and two completed combat units at that threat; verify suppression of the v35-motivated early Probe opportunity and first Probe acceptance at or after second-Gateway current
mechanism_reference.episode_reset: only after the public qualifying threat predicate becomes false
mechanism_reference.non_zerg_activity: all emergency-episode, bridge, reserve, and staged-offense fields empty, zero, or documented sentinel in non-Zerg lanes; accepted-build telemetry remains active for all races

notes: The v36 candidate must compile against native OpenBW and official BWAPI 4.4 headers before launch.
Root independently rebuilt the native and official-header targets; the native dylib was byte-identical to the worker build.

The v35 construction bookkeeping fix and cumulative emergency episode cap remain unchanged; the only v36 gameplay treatment is the 250-mineral Probe-production reserve from first-Pylon acceptance until second-Gateway current.
The v34 ZZZK values 2172 accepted, 2328 current, 3299 complete, with first Gateway accepted1392/current1768, are diagnostic references and not universal cross-seed timing bars.
The emergency episode cap is cumulative across unique Probe identities, not merely simultaneous defenders; defender death does not replenish capacity.
Use the exact prior-v35 opponent paths, hashes, maps, slots, and scenario seeds above. These matched inputs are intentionally reused and are not independent-Elo evidence.
No fixed 384-fps gate applies; report durable logical FPS and callback performance descriptively while enforcing wall caps and lifecycle gates.
This matched exploratory screen cannot update Elo; advancement requires every gate plus at least one verified win.
